```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Aggregate per-polygon CHM histogram bins into coarser height classes
# and compute proportion of polygon area in each class.
#
# Input: CSV exported from GEE with columns:
#   PlotID, mean, median, count, bin_0p0_0p5, bin_0p5_1p0, ..., bin_29p5_30p0
#
# Output: data frame with PlotID, mean, median, count, and proportion of
# polygon area in each of: 0-0.5, 0.5-1, 1-3, 3-5, 5-10, >10 m
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

# ---- Inputs ---------------------------------------------------------------
input_csv  <- paste0(dat_path,'dataIn/RS_Data/aim_rw_chm_stats_V3_NV.csv')   # adjust path as needed
output_csv <- "aim_rw_chm_classes_NV.csv"

# ---- Read -----------------------------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv(input_csv)

# ---- Define height classes ------------------------------------------------
# Each class lists the 0.5 m bin column names that compose it.
# Bins are labeled by their LEFT edge: bin_1p0_1p5 = pixels with height in [1.0, 1.5).
# So class "1-3 m" = bins with left edges 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5.

bin_name <- function(left_edge) {
  right_edge <- left_edge + 0.5
  sprintf("bin_%s_%s",
          gsub("\\.", "p", sprintf("%.1f", left_edge)),
          gsub("\\.", "p", sprintf("%.1f", right_edge)))
}

class_definitions <- list(
  "prop_0_0p1"  = bin_name(seq(0.0,  0.0,  by = 0.1)),  # just 0-0.5
  "prop_0_0p25"  = bin_name(seq(0.0,  0.0,  by = 0.25)),  # just 0-0.5
  "prop_0_0p5"  = bin_name(seq(0.0,  0.0,  by = 0.5)),  # just 0-0.5
  "prop_0p5_1"  = bin_name(seq(0.5,  0.5,  by = 0.5)),  # just 0.5-1
  "prop_0.5_3"    = bin_name(seq(0.5,  2.5,  by = 0.5)),  # 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5
  "prop_0.5_5"    = bin_name(seq(0.5,  4.5,  by = 0.5)),  # 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5
  "prop_0.5_30"    = bin_name(seq(0.5,  29.5,  by = 0.5)),  # 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5
  "prop_1_3"    = bin_name(seq(1.0,  2.5,  by = 0.5)),  # 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5
  "prop_1_5"    = bin_name(seq(1.0,  4.5,  by = 0.5)),  # 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5
  "prop_1_30"    = bin_name(seq(1.0,  29.5,  by = 0.5)),  # 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5
  "prop_3_30"    = bin_name(seq(3.0,  29.5,  by = 0.5)),  # 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5
  "prop_5_30"   = bin_name(seq(5.0,  29.5,  by = 0.5)),  # 5.0, 5.5, ..., 9.5
  "prop_gt10"   = bin_name(seq(10.0, 29.5, by = 0.5))   # 10.0 through 29.5
)

# ---- Build the aggregated data frame --------------------------------------
# For each class, sum the relevant bin columns row-wise, then divide by count.

result <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(Evaluation, mean, median, count)

for (class_name in names(class_definitions)) {
  bin_cols <- class_definitions[[class_name]]

  # Defensive: warn if any expected bin column is missing
  missing_cols <- setdiff(bin_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning(sprintf("Missing bin columns for %s: %s",
                    class_name, paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
    bin_cols <- intersect(bin_cols, names(df))
  }

  # Row-wise sum of bin counts in this class, divided by total pixel count.
  # Safe-divide: returns NA if count is 0 or NA.
  class_count <- rowSums(df[, bin_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  result[[class_name]] <- ifelse(
    is.na(df$count) | df$count == 0,
    NA_real_,
    class_count / df$count
  )
}

# ---- Sanity check: proportions should sum to ~1 ---------------------------
prop_cols <- names(class_definitions)
result$prop_sum_check <- rowSums(result[, prop_cols], na.rm = TRUE)

# Flag any rows where the sum deviates meaningfully from 1.
# (Small deviations are expected if any pixels exceed 30 m and fell outside
# the histogram range, but those should be rare in NV riparian.)
off_rows <- which(abs(result$prop_sum_check - 1) > 0.01 &
                    !is.na(result$prop_sum_check))
if (length(off_rows) > 0) {
  message(sprintf(
    "Note: %d polygons have proportions that don't sum to 1 (likely pixels >30 m or count issues).",
    length(off_rows)
  ))
}

# ---- Write ----------------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(result, output_csv)
message("Wrote: ", output_csv)
print(head(result))

```

# Load AIM Indicators and join

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
result
indicators_all <-  readRDS(paste0(dat_path,'/scratch/collated_field_indicators/aim_selected_indicators_wide.RDS')) %>% 
  filter(EvaluationID != ('CA-APFO-TW-24036_2024-08-30'))

rs_wide_all <- readRDS(paste0(dat_path,'scratch/rs_data_yearofsampling_wide.RDS'))%>% 
  filter(EvaluationID != ('CA-APFO-TW-24036_2024-08-30')) 

rw_plots <- readRDS(paste0(dat_path,'scratch/rw_plots.RDS')) %>% filter(EvaluationID != ('CA-APFO-TW-24036_2024-08-30'))

ind_chm<- indicators_all %>% inner_join(result %>% dplyr::select(EvaluationID=Evaluation, chm_mean = mean, chm_median = median,prop_0_0p5:prop_gt10)) %>% 
  left_join(rs_wide_all) %>% 
  left_join(rw_plots) %>% 
  filter(AvgWidthArea_1>10)

ind_chm %>% 
  pivot_longer(chm_mean:prop_gt10) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(value,FH_WoodyCover))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method='lm',se=FALSE)+geom_smooth(color='red',se=FALSE)+ggpubr::stat_cor()+facet_wrap(~name,scales='free_x')+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,100))


ind_chm %>% ggplot(aes(WetlandType, chm_mean))+geom_boxplot()
ind_chm %>% ggplot(aes(chm_mean,FH_WoodyCover))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method='lm')+geom_smooth(color='red',se=FALSE)+ggpubr::stat_cor()
ind_chm %>% ggplot(aes(chm_median,FH_WoodyCover))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method='lm')+geom_smooth(color='red',se=FALSE)+ggpubr::stat_cor()
ind_chm %>% ggplot(aes(chm_mean,s2_jas_ndvi_median_mean, fill=FH_WoodyCover))+
  geom_point(shape=21,size=3)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c()

lm(data=ind_chm, FH_ShrubCover~chm_mean*s2_jas_ndvi_median_mean+chm_mean*s2_amj_ndvi_median_mean) %>% summary(.)
```
